chunks: And it is narrated from Abī al-Ṣalt ʿAbd al-Salām ibn Ṣāliḥ al-Harawī, who said:
I heard al-Riḍā عليه السلام say: “By Allah, there is none among us except one who is killed as a martyr.”

So it was said to him: “Who will kill you, O son of the Messenger of Allah?” He said: “The worst of Allah’s creation in my time will kill me by poison, then bury me in a confined dwelling and in a land of estrangement. Indeed, whoever visits me in my estrangement, Allah, Mighty and Exalted, will write for him the reward of one hundred thousand martyrs, one hundred thousand truthful ones, one hundred thousand pilgrims performing hajj and ʿumrah, and one hundred thousand mujahids. He will be raised in our company and placed in the highest درجات of Paradise as our companion.”

key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise; the final abode of reward
key_terms.بِالسُّمِّ: by poison; describing the means of the Imam’s killing
key_terms.زُمْرَتِنَا: our group; the company of the Ahl al-Bayt in the Hereafter
key_terms.شَهِيدٌ: martyr; one slain in a state of sanctified testimony
key_terms.صِدِّيقٍ: truthful one; a person of the highest sincerity and truthfulness
key_terms.غُرْبَتِي: my estrangement; referring to the Imam’s burial far from his homeland
key_terms.مُجَاهِدٍ: one who performs jihad; a striver in the path of Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام in his place of estrangement?
ai.summary: This hadith reports Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام foretelling his martyrdom by poison and burial in a distant land. It also describes the immense reward for visiting him in his estrangement, including resurrection with the Ahl al-Bayt and elevation in the highest ranks of Paradise. The narration highlights both the suffering of the Imams and the spiritual merit of devotion to them.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3192 - It is narrated from Abu al-Salt Abd al-Salam ibn Salih al-Harawi, who said:

I heard Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as) say:
"By Allah (swt), there is none among us except that they are killed and martyred."

He was asked: "Who will kill you, O son of the Messenger of Allah (swt)?"
Imam (as) replied: "The worst of Allah’s (swt) creation in my time will kill me with poison, then bury me in a constrained house and a land of estrangement. Behold, whoever visits me in my estrangement, Allah (swt), the Mighty and Exalted, will write for them the reward of one hundred thousand martyrs, one hundred thousand truthful ones, one hundred thousand pilgrims and those performing Umrah, and one hundred thousand fighters in the path of Allah (swt). They will be resurrected in our group and placed in the highest ranks of Paradise as our companions."
